name: Cable Kneeling High Row
steps: Kneel facing a high pulley with knees hip-width apart and torso tall.
Reach upward to grip the handles with both arms extended forward and shoulders set down.
Draw your elbows down and back to pull the handles toward your upper ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades briefly, then extend both arms back toward the pulley under control.
tips: Keep your trunk tall and your shoulders away from your ears.
Brace your core and glutes so your lower back does not arch as you pull.
